positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for IPC (Inter Process Communication) development on mobile chipsets
	- Developed PCIe (Peripheral Component Interconnect Express) EP (endpoint) driver for LTE
 and 5G modem chipset.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for secure ROM and boot loader development on RTOS and Android platform based
	 on ARM chip sets
	- Developed ROM code of Central Power Management Core on ARM Cortex M0 and secure 
  bootloader of Application Processor on ARM Cortex A7 and ARM Cortex A53 64-bit processor.
	- Developed drivers on Central Power Management core.
	- Developed inter processor communication between CPM core and other cores.
	- Developed process for software patch integration, automated verification, and generation release 
  package.
	- Developed test bench for pre/post silicon verification of CPM code 
	- Performed CPM firmware release process which includes integration CPM code, debugging, 
  regression test, interface verification, version maintenance, and generation release package.

positions.title: Principal Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for system stabilizing of Android platform CDMA and UMTS smart phone products
Feb. 2009 – Oct. 2010
- Developed Panic Reporting App on Android (JAVA application)
- Developed BP panic handler in Android user space using IPC for CDMA system (Separate AP and BP solution, AP: OMAP3430, BP: QSC6085)
- Debugged critical stability and power-down issues.
- Responsible for integrating multimedia solution for product (HP camera driver, TI codec, Google framework, Motorola adaptation layer, and Motorola JAVA app)

	Linux platform CDMA product (Single process solution, Qualcomm AMSS6800 L4 based)
										Sep. 2007 – Jan. 2009
	- Implemented multimedia engine and APIs in Linux based software architecture.
	- Implemented glue layer to interface BREW APIs with Linux UI.

	Various CDMA products for Sprint (MSM6500, MSM6550) 		Jun. 2004 – Aug. 2007
- Developed camera driver for Micron MT9V112 based on Qualcomm camera service interface on AMSS6500
	- Modified and Revalidated Motorola display drivers to migrate to MDP from Qualcomm
	- Integrated AMSS to Motorola proprietary platform and UI software.
- Worked on stabilization of the products and resolved critical stability and power-down issues using JTAG and ETM devices.

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software team leader
- Responsible for developing GSM/GPRS mobile phone software
- Developed Tri mode (EGSM/DCS/PCS) dual LCD folder type phone using Skyworks solution
- Worked on LCD driver, phone book, and UI structure designs
- Set up software development environment
(Source management, Compile and debug environment, Coding standards, …)
- Trained software members

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Call processing part leader
	- Developed 1x EV-DO PCMCIA card using Qualcomm MSM5500 chipset solution
(Cellular band for SK Telecom, Dual band for US market)
	- Developed CDMA2000 1X PCMCIA card using Qualcomm MSM5105 chipset solution
(Dual band for US market, Modified to the module of Samsung PDA)

Senior Software Engineer
	- Developed IS-95B phone using Qualcomm MSM3100 chipset solution
	  (Single mode Cellular band for China market)
- Developed IS-95A phone using Qualcomm MSM3000 chipset solution
  (Single/Dual mode Cellular band for South American market)

	- Responsible for developing call processing software of CDMA mobile terminal
	- Designed hardware control codes for various model
	- Enhanced CDMA protocol for different systems
	- Modified features for various carriers (Authentication, PRL, …)
- Large experience of business trip for field test and approval
: USA, China, Venezuela, Mexico, Brazil, and Korea
- Co-worked with related companies and carriers 
: Qualcomm, Lucent, Telcel, Iusacell, Alltel, Verizon, and SK Telecom

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Multimedia Internet Protocol System project (Jan. 1997 – Jul. 1999)
- Ported H.323 protocol on the stand-alone IP terminal
- Programming under RTOS VRTX on MPC860

DECT (Digital European Cordless Telecommunications) project (May 1996 – Dec. 1996)
- Implemented Echo Canceller on DSP TMS320C54

	ATM NIM (Network Interface Module) project (Jan. 1995 – Apr. 1996)
- Designed ATM Layer board using commercial ATM chipset
- Implemented control software on 8051.

	PC based Color Video Phone development project (Jan. 1994 – Dec. 1994)
- Implemented video phone control Windows program
- Programming under the Visual C++ 1.0 on Microsoft Windows 3.1
